name: Turnip, Nori & Garlic
desc: Peppery turnip enriched with garlic and a measured marine nori accent
ing: 260 g small turnips, peeled and diced into 1 cm pieces
method: Wash, peel, trim and finely chop fresh ingredients as specified; use food-grade seaweed, pastes and ready-cooked pulses only.
Pour around 125 ml cold water into the soup maker; add everything except ingredients labelled (finish).
Top up to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, within the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX marks.
Run the Smooth programme for approximately 19 minutes.
Taste; nori should create umami rather than fishiness.
